name: How Long Does Gate Repair Really Take?

step.name: Step 1
step.text: The truth is, how long your gate repair takes really depends on what's going on with it. Some issues are pretty quick fixes, while others might take a little longer. For example, if it's just a simple adjustment or a safety sensor that needs realigning, we can often get that sorted out for you on the same visit. We carry a good stock of common parts, so if your repair needs something we have on hand, we can usually take care of it in just a few hours. However, if your gate needs a special-order motor, a specific panel, or a unique control board, that's when things can extend to a few days or even longer while we wait for the parts to arrive. Providing details like your gate's brand, model, and any prior repair history really helps us give you a more accurate timeframe from the get-go. No matter the issue, our goal at Frasheski Construction is to get your gate back in top shape efficiently, serving Berkeley, Oakland, and the wider East Bay area.
